statement.zh: Willey & Corbett 1954 专著记录苏佩河口等地（含阿斯佩罗）1941–42 发掘；当时陶瓷—查文视域下的绝对年代框架已过时，须与晚近前陶再认识对照。
statement.en: Willey & Corbett 1954 monograph documents 1941–42 excavations at Supe-mouth loci including Aspero; ceramic–Chavín absolute framing is outdated and must be read with later Preceramic reassessments.
